## What We Build & Sell (7 Core Capabilities)
1. **Inbound & Outbound AI Voice Agents**: Sub-800ms human-like voice agents handling 24/7 inbound appointment bookings and 60-second outbound speed-to-lead qualification calls.
2. **WhatsApp Bot & Chat Automations**: Official Meta Cloud API bots for instant customer replies, automated slot booking, reminders, catalogs, and re-engagement broadcasts.
3. **Intelligent Website AI Chatbots**: 24/7 contextual lead capture widgets that qualify prospects and trigger instant WhatsApp or voice follow-ups.
4. **Full-Funnel Performance Marketing**: Creative brand strategy and paid ad campaigns executed in partnership with The Axiom Grid that feed directly into automated AI calling funnels.
5. **Anti-Aggregator Custom Web Applications**: Zero-commission digital storefronts and direct-booking portals saving 15-30% on Zomato, Practo, and booking platforms.
6. **Local SEO, AEO & "GEO" (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Google Maps Top 3 rank and optimization to be cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
7. **Customer Database & Re-engagement**: 100% private CRM data ownership with automated follow-ups to increase customer retainers.
